task: Write SCRIPTS/soul-pipeline-ingest.js — a Node.js ingestion script that reads raw unprocessed soul text files from CANON/ and routes each through the soul-logger S2Pipeline at https://soul-logger.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev. RAW BUCKETS: (1) CANON/SOUL-DNA-RAW-MICHAEL-QUOTES-ALL-SESSIONS-2026-04-05.md — verbatim Markdown blockquotes (lines matching /^> "/ in Markdown); (2) CANON/SOUL-SEGMENTS/SOULDNA-ADDITIONAL-SEGMENTS-2026-04-05.md — JSONL (one JSON object per line); (3) CANON/SOUL-LOG-VERBATIM-KEY-SOUL10-2026-04-05.md — JSONL with L00001 style row IDs. PIPELINE: Step 1 STAGE 1 / RRL: POST /api/soul/extract with {text, source_format, source_date} → returns {session_id} written to D1; Step 2 STAGE 2 / SOUL: POST /api/soul/crunch with {session_id, mode= bible}; Step 3 STAGE 3 / LEDGER: auto-handled by appendToLedger() inside crunch/truth/shadow endpoints; Step 4 STAGE 4 / skeleton: POST /api/soul/skeleton with {session_id, student_id= sov100}; Step 6 STAGE 6 / 6-AI TRUTH: POST /api/soul/truth with focus_text= object.text; Step 7 STAGE 7 / SHADOW REALM: POST /api/soul/shadow with focus_text=object.text; Stage 10 APEX: GET /api/soul/apex?student_id=sov100&days=30&limit=5. On 5xx: log+skip (never block the batch). Output: OPERATIONS/raw-soul-ingress-classified-2026-05-23.jsonl and OPERATIONS/pipeline-run-log-2026-05-23.jsonl. Use native fetch in Node.js 18+. No AWS/other SDKs required.
context: Worker soul-logger (44355 bytes, v2.0 HARDENED, LANE-337, Run 393): Stage1 POST /api/soul/extract takes {text (string), source_format (optional string), source_date (optional ISO date)} → inserts into soul_sessions + soul_prompts D1 tables, returns {session_id(UUID), prompt_count, ingested_at}. Stage2 POST /api/soul/crunch {session_id(UUID), mode:string=bible|themes} → reads session from D1, calls WorkersAI (@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.1) then DeepSeek fallback (deepseek-v4-flash), inserts into soul_crunches, auto-fires appendToLedger(env, Event{eventType:soul_crunch_capture, studentId}), returns {crunch_id, ai_tier_used}. Stage4 POST /api/soul/skeleton {session_id(UUID), student_id:string} → reads soul_prompts for session, calls @cf/meta/llama-3-8b-instruct for 5-10 keywords, INSERT OR IGNORE into soul_keywords (UNIQUE on keyword+student_id), then UPDATE weight=N+1, returns {ok, keywords:[], session_id}. Stage6 POST /api/soul/truth {session_id(UUID)|focus_text} → reads session or focus_text, calls @cf/meta/llama-3-8b AND @cf/mistral-7b in parallel, parses JSON {directives[], charge_score, key_phrases[]} from each, consensus_score=round((A+B)/2), consensus_achieved=abs(A-B)<=3, inserts ledger event, returns {truth_id(UUID), consensus_score, consensus_achieved, agreed_directives[], key_phrases[]}. Stage7 POST /api/soul/shadow {session_id(UUID)|text} → reads session text or text field, calls @cf/mistral-7b as Dooku adversarial challenger, parses JSON {challenge, drift_indicators[], intensity_score(1-5), verdict}, inserts ledger event, returns {shadow_id(UUID), verdict, drift_indicators[], intensity_score}. Stage10 GET /api/soul/apex?student_id=sov100&days=30&limit=5 → scans last 100 soul_prompts joined with soul_sessions over last N days, scores each prompt via emotional_markers (caps_words*3 + exclamations*2 + profanity*10), returns {apex_score, soul_directives[{text, charge}], top_keywords[], total_prompts_scanned}. All URLs: https://soul-logger.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev. SOULCOUNT tracking query: SELECT SUM(byte_count) FROM soul_prompts WHERE session_id LIKE 'sov100%'. Student chat entries (huong-bluetech etc.) are excluded by default query — pass student=all for aggregate. D1 DB binding: env.DB. Fail-open: 5xx = log+continue. worker v2.0 sealed at LANE-337, DRIFT GATE active, HALT on seal breach.
